texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
texts.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into the portal. The rate of loss is far too small for it to make any difference to life on [Root.GetName], but the very existence of this portal raises some disturbing questions, such as where does it lead to, and could something come through the portal from the other side?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个邪恶的世界的。尝试跟该位面进行任何类型接触的生物体都会遭受到剧烈的痛楚，若是持续数分钟暴露在这种痛楚下，会产生强烈的暴力倾向。就连简单的采集该怪异位面的数据都会导致电脑系统出现不可修复的故障，或使得智能个体产生极大的不适。然而，我们发现骑士团的一件遗珍可以有效地保护佩戴者，并且可以让我们派出一名骑士进入。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any direct contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense violent urges. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings. However, we have found that one of the Order's relics wards its wearer effectively, and would allow us to send a single knight through.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通向了某个邪恶不安的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings due to the terrifying realization that one's very soul is being corrupted.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个从本质上对立于智慧意识的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm which is opposed to the sapient mind on a fundamental level. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes intense discomfort in the biological observer, and cascading errors in computer systems.

label.en: Find a way to close the Portal!

label.zh: 毒圣骑士 · 唯心主义 1
label.en: Knights of the Toxic God · Spiritualist 1

label.zh: 毒圣骑士 · 唯心主义 2
label.en: Knights of the Toxic God · Spiritualist 2

label.zh: 毒圣骑士 · 封建社会
label.en: Knights of the Toxic God · Feudal Society

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门可以容纳几乎无限的能量，但关键字是“几乎”。通过以前所未有的规模生产能量，并对传送门进行持续轰炸，最终导致传送门过载并坍塌了。很显然，生产巨大能量的能力也可以用于其它领域。
texts.en: The Portal was determined to be able to handle almost unlimited energy input, but the key word is "almost". By generating energy at an unprecedented scale and continuously bombarding the Portal, it was eventually possible to cause it to overload and collapse in on itself. Needless to say, the generation of vast amounts of energy has the potential to be useful in other areas.

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能力非常敏感。因此我们召集了一些天赋异禀的个体，在传送门周围制造了一个灵能屏障，将它与世隔绝开。这一经历启发了我们，并且证明了用灵能创造实体屏障是可行的。
texts.en: The Portal proved to be sensitive to psionic force. With an assembled team of gifted individuals, we created a psionic barrier around the portal, preventing any access. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to form solid barriers from psionic energy.

texts.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能输入非常敏感。我们利用灵能单元在传送门周围创造了一个灵能屏障，避免未授权访问。该事件获取的数据会在未来研究中大有可用。
texts.en: The Portal has proven to be sensitive to psionic input. Through the use of our psionic units, a barrier has been constructed around the portal, preventing unauthorized access. The data from this event will prove useful in our future research.

texts.zh: 传送门似乎会对附近观察者的思维产生某种反应，有些人产生的反应比其他人更大。通过筛选，我们挑选了一大群对传送门影响较大的人，用共同的意念关闭了传送门。这一经历启发了我们，并确实证明了信念的力量能被实际运用。
texts.en: The Portal seemed to react in some way to the thoughts of nearby observers, some more than others. Through a process of elimination it was possible to find a large number of people who were especially potent at influencing the Portal, and together they were able to effectively will the Portal to close. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to harness and direct belief in tangible ways.

texts.zh: 有时最简单的答案也是最好的答案。在将数座大山炸成碎石并倒进传送门之后，它似乎过载了，也有可能是被刻意关闭了。无论如何，我们仍将剩余的碎石倒在了传送门的位置上，以防止它再次开启。我们从这一经历中吸取了许多工程与采矿方面的经验，可以在其它领域派上用场。
texts.en: Sometimes a simple answer is the best answer. After blasting several mountains into gravel and dumping the result into the portal, it seems to have been overloaded. Or, perhaps, was deliberately shut down. Regardless, the remaining material was dumped on top of the site in case it ever re-opens. The experience of such a large engineering and mining project will also prove useful in other areas.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向由纯能量所形成的世界。我们成功通过传送门汲取少量的能量过来我们的世界。这些能量“包裹”拥有开发成武器的潜力。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure energy, a small amount of which can be siphoned through the portal for our own use. The procedures used to handle discrete "packets" of energy also have potential use as a weapons system.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门通往一个由纯粹的熵构成的次元。就连传感器都几乎无法取得读数，因为我们信号的能量很快就消散了。最具可信度的理论是，这一“太虚”的大多数零点能量都为负，任何曾经存在的正能量都早已耗尽。我们或许可以制造一种武器，将太虚的能量消散特性化为武器。
texts.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure entropy. It is difficult to even get sensor readings because the very energy of our pings is rapidly dissipated. Our best theory is that this "Null Void" is a dimension where the majority of zero-point energy is negative and so any positive energy which was once present has long since been used up. Knowing this, it might be possible to construct a weapon which can use the Null Void's energy destruction offensively.

texts.zh: 在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。
texts.en: After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

texts.zh: 一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。
texts.en: A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

texts.zh: 奇怪的是，[Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通往一个与[Root.GetName]非常相似的星球。更奇怪的是，里面有一个信号正向我们传来……
texts.en: Strangely, the Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to connect to a planet which looks very much like [Root.GetName]. Stranger still, there's a signal being broadcast to us through it...

texts.zh: 我是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。传送门外星人，你们是谁？
texts.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Who are you, Portal-aliens?

texts.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。表明你的身份！
texts.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Identify!

label.zh: 校验错误：身份无效！这里是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]！表明你的身份！
label.en: Checksum error: invalid ID! This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]! Identify!

texts.zh: 这太神奇了。如果你说的是真的，我想这座传送门应该是连通平行世界的桥梁。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，但在某一时点上，我们各自次元中一定发生了某种差异，使我们的世界线产生了分歧。
texts.en: Fascinating. If what you say is true, I think this portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both the [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], but at some point an event must have caused our respective dimensions to diverge.

texts.zh: **处理中！** 结果：这道传送门连通着次元之间的缝隙。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，来自不同的次元。
texts.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: This portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], from divergent dimensions.

label.zh: 真神奇。告诉我们你们那的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]过得如何。
label.en: Amazing. Tell us how your [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] fare!

label.zh: 我们应该通过传送门进行贸易。
label.en: We should trade through our portal.

label.zh: 一个未计算的变量。报告另一个[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的状况！
label.en: An uncalculated variable. Report status of alternate [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

texts.zh: 我想应该和你们那边差不多。我们从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]向太空中发展，利用新发明的曲速引擎——
texts.en: Much the same as it fares in your dimension, I expect. We have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

texts.zh: 在发明曲速引擎之后，[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]开始向星海进发——
texts.en: The [Root.Owner.Species.GetName] have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

label.zh: 曲速引擎？我们用的是超空间航道！
label.en: The Warp Drive? We travel by Hyperlanes!

label.zh: 错误！意外值：曲速引擎。预期值：超空间航道。
label.en: Error! Unexpected value: Warp Drive. Expected value: Hyperlanes.

texts.zh: 超空间航道？或许发现不同类型的超光速旅行方法，正是我们平行世界之间的分歧点？这是否意味着你们并未受到曲速兽的侵扰？
texts.en: Hyperlanes? Perhaps discovering different types of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes? Does this mean you are not beset by the Warp beasts?

texts.zh: **处理中！** 结果：探索出不同类型的超光速旅行方式是我们宇宙之间的分歧点。查询：曲速兽袭击？
texts.en: **PROCESSING!** Results: Discovering a different type of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes. Query: Warp beast assault?

label.zh: 没听说过什么曲速兽。它们构成了很大的威胁吗？
label.en: No Warp beasts here. Are they a serious threat?

label.zh: 值未找到：曲速兽。查询：曲速兽威胁等级？
label.en: Value not found: Warp beasts. Query: Threat level of Warp beasts?

texts.zh: 曲速兽会攻击所有已知的文明。它们是所有生命之敌。据我们所知，一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界程度，曲速兽就会苏醒并攻击。已经有数个物种被它们消灭了，但目前我们还撑得住。
texts.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all life. As far as we have determined, once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

texts.zh: 曲速兽袭击所有已知文明，它们是所有存在的威胁。假设：一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界值，曲速兽将觉醒并攻击。数个物种已灭亡，但目前我们仍撑得住。
texts.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all existence. Hypothesis: Once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

label.zh: 听起来真可怕。我们能帮上忙吗？
查询：你是否需要物质支援？
label.en: Query: Do you require material support?

texts.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济形势大好。其原因包括我们之间的传送门贸易，以及最近在对抗曲速兽时取得了一系列胜利。
texts.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is booming. Contributing factors mentioned were our Portal Trade, as well as recent victories over the Warp beasts.

texts.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济最近较为萧条，原因是在对抗曲速兽时吃了一连串败仗。
texts.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is in decline due to a series of defeats at the appendages of the Warp beasts.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]已被吞噬。[Root.Owner.GetName]已陷落。据我们所知，[Root.GetName]是唯一残存的殖民地。四面八方都是曲速兽！它们来了！

**信号突然中断**
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] has been consumed. The [Root.Owner.GetName] has fallen. As far as we know, [Root.GetName] is the last remaining colony. The Warp beasts are everywhere! They are here!

**The signal abruptly ends**

texts.zh:
状态更新：[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]离线。[Root.Owner.GetName]战斗能力：理想值的23%。剩余殖民地网络：[Root.GetName]。预期结果：曲速兽将在2个太阳周期内完全胜利。错误！[Root.GetName]轨道内发现曲速兽活动！错误！

**信号突然中断**
texts.en:
Status update: [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] offline. [Root.Owner.GetName] combat capacity: 23% of optimal. Remaining Colony network: [Root.GetName]. Expected results: Total Warp beast victory within 2 solar cycles.  Error! Warp beast activity detected in [Root.GetName] orbit! Error!

**The signal abruptly ends**

texts.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今此人回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]形态扭曲，被黑暗笼罩，带领了一支恐怖之军穿过了传送门，立马开始袭击我们的殖民地。幸存者称他们听到[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]爆发出恶魔般的笑声，并宣称[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]将很快征服这个位面。
texts.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. Twisted and darkened, [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] led a host of horrors through the portal and immediately assaulted our colony. Survivors reported hearing [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] erupt in a demonic cackle, claiming [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] would soon conquer this dimension.

texts.zh: 我们数年前将[doomslayer_knight.GetName]送去[Root.GetName]上的传送门，现在这个传送门正在释放强烈的活跃信号，一些衣衫褴褛的平民似乎正试图穿越到我们的位面。他们汇报称，[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]骑士已经在他们的位面肆虐了十几年，无情地屠戮着任何出现在[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]面前的人。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]在那个未免杀害了那么多居民，甚至对他们的社会造成了毁灭性的影响。幸存者无助地向任何能抵达的地方逃亡。难道是这个位面的痛苦使[doomslayer_knight.GetName]陷入了疯狂？
texts.en: The portal on [Root.GetName] where we sent Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] years ago is showing intense signs of activity as ragged civilians appear to be attempting to cross into our dimension. They report that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] has been rampaging in their dimension for a decade now, mercilessly slaughtering everyone crossing [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] path. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] slew so many inhabitants of that dimension that a doom has befallen their society. The survivors are trying to flee anywhere they can. Could the existential pain caused by this dimension have driven [doomslayer_knight.GetName] to madness?

texts.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今已经回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]历经万难，击败了无数的敌人，几乎是侥幸地保全了[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的性命，但最终，没有什么能阻挡[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]的去路。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]带回了许多战利品，并在扈从间成为了传说，大家开始称[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]为“末日杀手”。
texts.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] bested many a challenge, felled countless fiends and narrowly avoided [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] doom, but ultimately, nothing could stand in [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] way. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] brought back many trophies and has become a legend amongst the squires, who have begun calling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] "Doomslayer".

label.en: [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is truly brave, ferocious and gallant!

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的次元传送门自发关闭了。在我们稳定传送门后，看到它通向一个延绵不断的白色、无构造的虚空，仅有黑色噪点的随机条带穿插其中。这个奇怪的现象立刻开始渗入我们的宇宙并吞噬我们的稳定器，使得传送门发生了坍缩。

传送门、虚空和次元稳定器在同一个瞬间消失了，什么都没有留下，甚至连痕迹粒子都没有。若不是连传送门都没有稳定下来，谁知道这里将会发生何等灾难。
texts.en:
The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] shut itself. When we stabilized the portal, we saw that it led to a dimension consisting solely of a white, formless void interrupted only by random streaks of black noise. The strange phenomenon instantly started to seep into our universe and consumed our dimensional stabilizers, collapsing the gateway.

The portal, static, and dimensional stabilizers have all winked out of existence simultaneously. Nothing was left behind; not even trace particles. If the portal hadn't been unstable, who knows what kind of disaster might have occurred here.

texts.zh: 最近，我们位于[Root.GetHomeWorldName]主要物理实验室的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在工作中发现了怪异的波动。与超空间有关的实验受到的干扰最为严重，但这些干扰仅仅持续了一周左右就彻底消失了。与此同时，[From.GetName]在那处已经关闭的传送门发现了一些波动，幸好那种不可能的虚空没有重现。希望这不会引起进一步的后果。
texts.en: Recently our [Root.GetScientistPlural] working in our primary physics lab on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have noticed strange fluctuations in their work. Our hyperdrive-related tests suffered most from these interferences, yet these interruptions only went on for about a week before stopping entirely. At the same time [From.GetName] noticed fluctuations from the now closed dimensional portal, thankfully the impossible static did not return. Hopefully, nothing will come of this.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份尖端科学单元[cloned_physicist.GetName]发来的新报告。报告中阐述了关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质粒子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]在报告中称。

威胁分析子例程则建议在这一全新的不明物质被鉴定完毕之前先让舰队返回母星系。
texts.en:
A new report from lead physics unit [cloned_physicist.GetName] was received today. The report included recent findings of the spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes immensely as well as related subjects," reports science unit [cloned_physicist.GetName].

Threat analysis subroutines suggest bringing fleets home until the source of this new and untested material can be determined.

texts.zh:
我们收到了物理特化工蜂[cloned_physicist.GetName]的新观测结果，内容是关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”工蜂反馈称。

我们的意识不信任这一突然的发展和独特的感觉，敦促部分舰队返回母星系。
texts.en:
New observations from physics specialized drone [cloned_physicist.GetName] have been disseminated regarding the recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes and additional related subjects," reports the drone.

The Mind is untrusting of this sudden development and instinctively feels an urge to return some fleets to the spawning system.

texts.zh:
今天，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的科学界举行了一场充满了渴求与焦虑的学术报告，[cloned_physicist.GetName]发表了[cloned_physicist.GetHerHis]关于[Root.Capital.GetStarName]附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进我们对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]声称！

我们的海军部则对这些课题抱有不同的看法，并建议我们立刻让舰队返回母星系，直到这种全新的未知物质的来源被探明为止。
texts.en:
Eager and anxious discourse started in the scientific circles of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] today as [cloned_physicist.GetName] published [cloned_physicist.GetHerHis] recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

"These findings could advance our understanding of artificial wormholes and a host of other subjects," proclaims [cloned_physicist.GetName]!

Our Admiralty holds a different view on the subject and suggests we bring our fleets home until the source of this new and untested matter can be determined.

texts.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的科学单元，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: Additional science units had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

texts.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的工蜂，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: Additional drones had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]最伟大的头脑汇聚一堂，倾听[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于利用这些负向物质离子的最新想法，没想到报告被突然打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。地平线上，一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
texts.en: The greatest minds of the [Root.GetName] gathered today to listen to [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest ideas for using the negative mass particles, only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over horizons while a small fleet of fighters pours through the tear.

texts.zh: 我们的母星周围最近出现了负相物质。这种奇怪的现象肯定不是动摇我们社会根基的事情的预兆。
texts.en: Negative Mass has recently appeared around our homeworld. The strange phenomenon surely won't be a herald of something that will shake our society's very core.

texts.zh: 调查位面传送门通向何方。
texts.en: Investigate where the Dimensional Portal leads to.

texts.zh: 通过科学研究一定可以找到关闭这个传送门的方法！
texts.en: There has to be a way to close this portal, and science will find it!

texts.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用正能量来反制！
texts.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with positive energy!

texts.zh: 这个传送门一定可以用灵能来反制！
texts.en: Such a portal can surely be countered with Psionic energy!

texts.zh: 往里丢足够多的石头，或许可以把它堵住？
texts.en: Perhaps dumping enough rock into the portal will block it up?

texts.zh: 无论是什么样的力量在将暗物质带往我们的传送门，将其更多的吸引过来应该可以增加暗物质的产出。
texts.en: Whatever the strange force bringing Dark Matter to our portal is, attracting a higher level of it should result in increased production.
